title: His father's death and the Chesterfield overcoat
summary: His father died when Cobb was six; he remembers him mainly for a gray Chesterfield coat with a fur collar and how proud he was of new clothes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You died when your -- your father died when you were six.

I vaguely remember him, but I had something to remember him by. He gave me a Chesterfield overcoat, and I don't know Stanley, if you know what a Chesterfield overcoat, to my knowledge, what it was, but it had the fur around the collar.

You know, and it was kind of -- something down the -- but it was gray with the black fur around it and I was the sharpest little youngster and I was proud of me and I'd go out there and say, 'See my new coat?' You know, I'm proud. I'd get a pair of new shoes and I'd say -- my mother'd say, 'Come

" " here, boy, sit down. " See my new shoes? " I let everybody know anything I had new, in church, anywhere. I was proud of it. That was my nature. I didn't know it then. I found out later. And anything I got new I'd like to share it with everybody today.
